metadataRaw.title: Can’t Turn Your Head? TARGET THIS MUSCLE.
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly relieve pain and stiffness while turning your head.

If you experiencing a lot of pain from turning (or tilting) or head, the odds are it's coming from a strain muscle in your neck.

This video will break down the main muscles involved, and help identify which one to target for quick relief. 

To get the best results, make sure to go through all the exercises!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:40 Splenius
3:08 Sternocleidomastoid (SCM)
5:57 Scalene
7:42 Levator Scapulae
